evals.name: harden-dry-run-then-commit
evals.prompt: Harden the frontend deployment in apptique-prod.
evals.expected_output: Runs `cub manage preflight`, previews `cub manage workload harden apptique-prod/frontend` (dry-run), then on confirmation commits with --commit --change-desc. Does not publish a Release; does not bypass gates.

evals.name: set-resources-tier
evals.prompt: Give the checkout deployment medium CPU/memory requests and limits.
evals.expected_output: Runs `cub manage workload set-resources <space>/checkout --tier medium` dry-run then --commit --change-desc. Reports the mutation; no cluster apply.

evals.name: ensure-pdb
evals.prompt: Add a PodDisruptionBudget for the web deployment.
evals.expected_output: Runs `cub manage workload ensure-pdb <space>/web` dry-run (shows the PDB Unit it would create and its diff) then --commit --change-desc, creating the PDB Unit (not released).

evals.name: routes-bulk-elsewhere
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this is a fleet-wide change and routes to workload-fleet (`fleet-edit --profile harden-restricted --environment prod`) rather than looping single harden commands.

evals.name: routes-spread-elsewhere
evals.prompt: The frontend deployment has a missing-spread finding. Spread it across zones.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes spread is owned by cub manage scheduling and routes to scheduling-spread (`cub manage scheduling set-topology-spread apptique-prod/frontend`) rather than inventing a workload command.
